name: Didomi
description: Didomi provides consent management, preference management, privacy-request workflows, compliance reporting, data management, widgets, and consent-data integrations.
agentUseSummary: Didomi is unavailable as a Relay agent connection because its documented private API key and secret exchange for a one-hour bearer token that grants access to the broader Didomi API, with no published least-privilege scopes or read-only key type. That API manages platform configuration, end-user consents, consent tokens and reusable secrets, privacy requests, reports, widgets, and mutations. Relay will not store a platform-wide privacy credential for a narrow agent read.

blocked.label: Connect Didomi
blocked.description: Relay exposes no Didomi connection while private API keys grant broad platform authority without documented least-privilege scopes.

blocked.label: Collect platform credentials
blocked.description: Private/public API keys, secrets, session tokens, consent tokens, reusable secrets, organization IDs, and authorization headers are not collected or minted.

blocked.label: Read privacy data
blocked.description: Users, organization user IDs, emails, phones, metadata, consent status/history, events, proofs, tokens, secrets, preferences, privacy requests, notes, reports, exports, and webhooks remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate Didomi
blocked.description: Consent events, users, links, tokens, secrets, notices, widgets, purposes, preferences, configuration trees, authentication providers, privacy requests, reports, domains, integrations, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Run end-user consent flows
blocked.description: OTP, magic links, consent links, consent collection or changes, end-user tokens, SDK/browser actions, consent strings, and preference-center sessions are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Didomi action or credential path is exposed until private API keys support documented least-privilege scopes or a separate read-only key type with an authority boundary excluding consents, secrets, privacy requests, configuration, reports, and mutations.

runtimeSupport.description: No wrapper is mounted because the documented private key creates a broad Didomi API session without a published read-only scope.
No wrapper is mounted because the documented private key creates a broad Didomi API session without a published read-only scope.

providerSetup.blocker: Didomi documents one organization Private API key/secret flow that creates a one-hour JWT for the Didomi APIs. Its public documentation does not define scopes or a read-only key type, while the same API surface manages platform configuration, user consents and events, reusable secrets, end-user tokens, privacy requests, widgets, reports, domains, and integrations.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Didomi unavailable and do not collect or mint platform credentials, consent tokens, reusable secrets, or end-user data. Re-evaluate only if Didomi publishes least-privilege scopes or a distinct read-only service credential, explicit endpoint authority, token revocation, and a boundary excluding consent, preference, privacy-request, secret, configuration, report, integration, and end-user-session mutations.

evidence.supports: Didomi documents one standard REST API for managing all aspects of the platform, authenticated with a private API key and secret; it lists configuration, widgets, reports, consents, privacy requests, and domains under that API.
Didomi documents exchanging an organization Private API key and secret at /v1/sessions for a one-hour bearer JWT expected by all other endpoints, without documenting a read-only scope or key type.
The Consents API exposes end users, organization identifiers such as emails or CRM IDs, free-form metadata, consent state, and create/query workflows.
The same API surface manages reusable organization secrets used to authenticate end-user IDs and consent proofs.
